_comment: Single machine-readable identity of the terminal application artifact for 076-f. Both scripts/certification/build-provenance.mjs and scripts/certification/build-assessment.mjs read THIS file, so the identity is stated once and cannot drift between them. Update it only with a real build record: terminalSourceSha = the latest commit that changes an app or build input; terminalApkSha256 = the SHA-256 of the release APK built from that tree and hashed off the device. An evidence-only commit does not change it.
